articles.summary: The Medical Device & Manufacturing West (MD&M West) tradeshow was held February 6-8 in Anaheim, CA with over 1,600 exhibitors and more than 14,000 attendees from the medical industry. Top medical device and equipment makers, power supply providers, thought leaders and engineers attend. Once again, Advanced Energy (AE) played a significant role as a featured exhibitor.
articles.title: Powering What Matters: AE Addresses Four Key Medical Trends at MD&M West 2024

articles.summary: IEC 60601-1 is the most critical international safety specification for the design of medical electrical equipment. This standard defines classifications that impact safety-related design, which are based on how systems interact with patients.
articles.title: Safety Requirements in Medical Equipment: Designing for BF and CF Classifications
